maddeler.e:
أقترئ (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِئُ (ʔaqtariʔu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# أَقْتَرِئَ (ʔaqtariʔa) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# أَقْتَرِئْ (ʔaqtariʔ) /ʔaq.ta.riʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
